edges.reason: Put reads and updates the Acc[msg.sender] Holder record.
Put executes acc.balance += msg.value without overflow checks.
Put assigns acc.unlockTime using a timestamp-dependent ternary expression.
The _unlockTime parameter flows into the unlockTime assignment.
block.timestamp (now) determines the effective unlock time value.
msg.sender is used as the key to index the Acc mapping.
Put calls LogFile.AddMessage which appends to Log.History.
Collect performs the low-level external call to the caller.
The external call target is fully controlled by msg.sender.
The balance decrease executes only after the untrusted external call returns.
Collect updates acc.balance after the external interaction.
The _am parameter is forwarded as msg.value to the untrusted external call.
_am is subtracted from acc.balance without underflow protection.
Collect's guard depends on now > acc.unlockTime.
Collect compares acc.balance against the MinSum state variable.
Collect calls LogFile.AddMessage on the external Log contract.
The fallback function delegates execution to Put(0).
The constructor writes the Log address into LogFile.
The log parameter is stored into the LogFile state variable.
AddMessage writes Sender, Val, Data and Time into LastMsg.
AddMessage pushes LastMsg into the History array.
AddMessage stores block.timestamp (now) into LastMsg.Time.
The _adr parameter is written into LastMsg.Sender.
The _val parameter is written into LastMsg.Val.
The _data parameter is written into LastMsg.Data.

msg.sender is used in Collect for the mapping lookup and the external call.

The local acc pointer in Collect aliases Acc[msg.sender].

The subtraction mutates the Acc balance storage slot.
